name: Cor
description:
Cor turns your product's onboarding into a feedback loop you can work with directly from your assistant.

Connect a client and you can browse your tutorial library, run semantic searches over your product knowledge, read real user session transcripts, and review the findings that surface from those sessions, including blockers, knowledge gaps, and points of confusion.

Then you can act on what you find. Your assistant can draft new tutorials and revisions, and write knowledge corrections that override your base knowledge and resolve open findings. Every tutorial change is created as an unpublished draft, so nothing reaches your users until an admin reviews and publishes it.

Sign in with Google or Microsoft. There are no API keys to manage. Access is scoped to your account's product, and read and write permissions are granted separately so you can share only what you intend to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.coragents.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cor lists 14 MCP tools, including create_knowledge_patch, create_tutorial_draft, get_authoring_guidance, get_knowledge_patch, get_session_transcript, get_tutorial, get_use_cases, list_findings, list_knowledge_patches, list_sessions, list_tutorials, and search_knowledge.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cor in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Cor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cor is developed by Cor. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
